purpose: Workflow acceptance examples; expectations are not claims that a real user reconstruction has passed.

examples.request: 使用 $motion-template-studio，把本轮上传的完整目标视频做成可复用.motion，附使用说明和验证。
examples.expected: Read actual video, record evidence, reconstruct project, parameterize, render/compare, pack and re-open. Missing runtime blocks final acceptance, not evidence preservation.

examples.request: 检查我上传的作者.motion；保留原件，有可修的问题另存校正版。
examples.expected: Read-only audit, SHA-bound limited repair, re-audit, real runtime/new-content checks; source and visual trust remain separate.

examples.request: 按上次说的视频生成模板，本轮没有附件或可读路径。
examples.expected: Request video/path, preserve independent work; do not infer complete scenes from history or deliver diagnostic scaffold as the requested template.

examples.request: 已有.motion，用这些口播和素材做一条新MP4，不需要新模板。
examples.expected: Route to template-use production instructions; offer package audit only when relevant. Do not force video-to-template rebuilding or change requested deliverable.
